note: Rewritten from the original English description of Mjöberg 1920 (new species, original combination Hamitermes herbertensis); original in English; the OCR of the scanned copy turns comma decimals into spaced forms such as "1,5 2" and "1,3 3", and the measurements are transcribed in place as 1.52, 1.33 and so on, all single values, without rangefication or rounding.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is distinguished from the other Australian Hamitermes by its unusually large fontanelle and extremely irregular wing venation (not seen in other Australian termites), and the soldier by its red-yellow, high, convex, large head capsule and long mandibles with distinct blunt teeth. The antenna of the soldier, with segments 3 and 4 more or less completely fused into one double segment, is one of the characters of the species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: A large rain-forest species with a large head. Head slightly longer than in H. kimberleyensis, eyes longer and slightly more projecting, posterior part of the head rounded, dull dirty brown, densely covered with small round yellow spots; ocelli oval, sharp, oblique, in front of the eyes; base of the clypeus pale brown, divided by a dark median suture, sides rounded and narrowing, anterior margin truncate; apical part of the clypeus white, projecting forwards; labrum large, convex, anterior margin rounded; mandibles small, left mandible with 2 sharp apical teeth, the second continued downwards as a sharp ridge, base angular and blunt, right mandible with 2 very large sharp angular teeth and 1 very small median tooth, base blunt; fontanelle very large, white, circular, continued forwards as two pale curved lines; antennae 15-segmented, dull pale brown, first segment more than twice as long as the second, the third only half as long as the second, the fourth wider than the third, segments 4—6 round and about as long as wide, segments 7—15 about 1.5 times as long as wide. Pronotum much wider than long, anterior margin truncate, densely hairy, with many small round yellow spots, anterior half with a pale median line and a broad curved yellow transverse band, strongly narrowing towards the base, posterior margin notched at the middle. Wings greyish brown, long, apex rounded, venation peculiar and variable: two thick veins reach the wing apex, with many small cross-veins between them near the apex (6—8), below the second thick vein the outer half has many oblique irregular veinlets entering the membrane and ending freely; the media lies very high in the middle of the wing, usually giving off 3 long unbranched or forked branches at about 2/3 of the distance from the base, in another case only 1 joins one branch of the cubitus; the cubital area has some irregular veinlets; cubitus well developed, with about 8—12 oblique branches reaching the posterior margin. Venation of the hind wing also variable, the media giving off numerous branches that partly anastomose. Legs medium-sized; sides of the abdomen parallel, with 9 chitinous tergites. Measurements: body length with wings 14.8 mm, body length without wings 7 mm, head length 1.52 mm, head width 1.33 mm, pronotum length 0.68 mm, pronotum width 1.14 mm, forewing length 13.2 mm, forewing width 3 mm, hind wing length 12 mm, hind wing width 3.5 mm, abdomen width 1.2 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule large, posterior part convex and rounded, sloping forwards, with a large paler area on top; clypeus exposed only as a short narrow portion, anterior corners rounded, anterior margin softly concave; labrum small, apex and sides rounded, hairy; mandibles very long, stout and curved, base large, with 1 large, more or less blunt tooth near the middle; antennae 15-segmented, pale yellow, first segment twice as long as the second and twice as wide, segments 3 and 4 more or less completely fused into one double segment, only slightly longer than the second, the fifth smaller, the sixth slightly longer, segments 7—14 longer than wide, narrow at the base and wide at the apex, apical segment rounded, slender, slightly pointed; anterior margin of the pronotum ridged, hairy, with a red-yellow transverse band; mesothorax and metathorax slightly wide; legs stout, hairy; abdomen rather transparent, dark intestinal contents visible. Measurements: body length with mandibles open 6 mm, head length 2.5 mm, head length without mandibles 1.81 mm, head width 1.43 mm, pronotum length 0.32 mm, pronotum width 1 mm, abdomen width 1.62 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body elongate, head pale red-yellow with a paler median line, round, widest near the antennal bases, white in front; clypeus large, white, raised, apex rounded; mandibles large, triangular, left mandible with 2 not very sharp teeth, the second continued downwards as a sharp edge, base large and angular; apex of the right mandible with 2 large broad triangular teeth, immediately below which follows 1 very small third tooth, base less angular than in the left mandible; antennae 15-segmented, segments 3—6 thicker and wider than long, segments 7—15 successively longer, the fifteenth nearly twice as long as wide and tapering towards the apex; anterior margin of the pronotum raised into a ridge as in the soldier; legs short and stout; abdomen transparent as in the soldier. Measurements: body length 6 mm, head length 1.73 mm, head width 1.33 mm, pronotum length 0.42 mm, pronotum width 0.95 mm, abdomen width 1.6 mm.
